api.name: convohop
api.summary: ConvoHop communication plane (conversations, messages, realtime events and live sessions) and management plane (organizations, deployments and projects).

errors.summary: GraphQL errors carry these extensions. Classify errors by extensions, never by message text. Errors may arrive with HTTP 200.

outcome.summary: rejected: the request did not commit. unknown: it may have committed; resolve or retry it with the same requestId.

retryable.summary: Whether a later attempt with the same requestId may succeed.

planes.name: communication
planes.summary: Conversations, members, messages, receipts, realtime events and live sessions inside one project.

rules.summary: Communication requests always name their project explicitly.
Copy incarnation and servingEpoch from the current signed route. Stale values fail with INCARNATION_MISMATCH or WRONG_REGION.
Delivery permits authorize only credential redemption and acknowledgement.

planes.name: management
planes.summary: Organizations, deployments, projects, backend keys and webhooks.

rules.summary: Management operations select projects through operation input.
Delivery permits never authorize management operations.

credentials.name: backendKey
credentials.summary: Scoped project backend key. Server runtimes only; never ship it to clients.

credentials.name: deliveryPermit
credentials.summary: Signed permit from management.credentialPermit, sent in the request context of a request without a bearer token.

credentials.name: portalCredential
credentials.summary: Operator credential for the management plane. Server runtimes only.

credentials.name: userSession
credentials.summary: Short-lived user session token that your backend obtains with issueSession. Safe for client runtimes.

scopes.name: callManage
scopes.summary: Read, alert and end any live session in the project.

scopes.name: callRead
scopes.summary: Read any live session in the project, with its participants and operations.

scopes.name: conversationManage
scopes.summary: Create, read and update any conversation in the project.

scopes.name: historyManage
scopes.summary: Expand the history visible to members.

scopes.name: membershipManage
scopes.summary: Read and change conversation membership and broadcast permissions, and read or set the push mute of the member named by actAsPrincipalId. Requests that use actAsPrincipalId are audited.

scopes.name: messageRead
scopes.summary: Read history, get messages and search in any conversation of the project, or read as the member named by actAsPrincipalId. The inbox requires actAsPrincipalId. Requests that use actAsPrincipalId are audited.

scopes.name: messageWrite
scopes.summary: Send messages as the backend's service principal, or as the member named by actAsPrincipalId. Requests that use actAsPrincipalId are audited.

scopes.name: sessionManage
scopes.summary: Revoke user sessions and inspect session request outcomes.

conditions.name: authorOrModerator
conditions.summary: The caller wrote the message or moderates the conversation.

conditions.name: creatorOrModerator
conditions.summary: The caller started the live session or moderates its conversation.

conditions.name: member
conditions.summary: The caller is an active member of the conversation.

conditions.name: operationParticipant
conditions.summary: The caller started the operation or can access its target.

conditions.name: ownRequest
conditions.summary: The caller made the original request.

conditions.name: ownSession
conditions.summary: The session belongs to the caller.

conditions.name: owner
conditions.summary: The caller owns the organization, deployment or project.

conditions.name: participant
conditions.summary: The caller holds the referenced participation in the live session.

idempotency.name: ephemeral
idempotency.summary: Transient signal. Not deduplicated or retried; send a fresh signal instead.

idempotency.name: idempotent
idempotency.summary: Retry with the same requestId and identical input within the retry budget. The authority deduplicates by requestId; resolve an unknown outcome with resolveRequest.

idempotency.name: permitBound
idempotency.summary: Authorized by a single-delivery permit. Retry with the same requestId and permit; outcomes cannot be resolved by lookup.

idempotency.name: replayOnly
idempotency.summary: Retry with the same requestId and identical input within the retry budget; the authority answers a repeat with the original outcome. Outcomes cannot be resolved by lookup, so settle an unknown outcome by sending the same request again.

idempotency.name: safe
idempotency.summary: Read-only. Repeat freely; each attempt may use a new requestId.

idempotency.name: singleUse
idempotency.summary: Like idempotent, but the result carries a short-lived credential for one connection. Request a new one instead of reusing an expired result.

pagination.name: bounded
pagination.summary: One bounded page without a cursor input. complete reports whether every item fit.

pagination.name: cursor
pagination.summary: Server-ordered pages. Pass nextCursor back as the cursor input until complete is true.

pagination.name: replay
pagination.summary: Committed events in ascending sequence after a cursor. Persist the last applied cursor; invalid or expired cursors fail and are never reset silently.

pagination.name: sequence
pagination.summary: Newest first. Pass nextCursor back as the sequence cursor input to read older items until complete is true.

codes.name: ADMISSION_LIMIT
codes.summary: A rate, size or concurrency admission limit was reached. Back off, then retry with the same requestId.

codes.name: ALREADY_CONNECTED
codes.summary: The participation already has an active media connection.

codes.name: ALREADY_EXISTS
codes.summary: A resource with the same unique key already exists.

codes.name: AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE
codes.summary: The authority is temporarily unavailable. Retry with the same requestId.

codes.name: BILLING_CATALOG_CONFLICT
codes.summary: The billing provider's catalog conflicts with the configured price book, for example a duplicated or unsafe object. An operator must resolve it.

codes.name: BILLING_CATALOG_NOT_SYNCED
codes.summary: The billing provider's catalog does not match the configured price book yet. An operator must sync it.

codes.name: BILLING_CUSTOMER_MISSING
codes.summary: The organization has no billing account yet. Start a checkout first.

codes.name: BILLING_LINK_EXPIRED
codes.summary: The billing link of this request is no longer valid. Send a new request with a new requestId.

codes.name: BILLING_NOT_CONFIGURED
codes.summary: Billing is not configured in this environment.

codes.name: BILLING_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE
codes.summary: The plan is not offered for self-service checkout.

codes.name: BILLING_PROVIDER_CHANGED
codes.summary: The organization's billing account belongs to a different billing provider.

codes.name: BILLING_PROVIDER_REJECTED
codes.summary: The billing provider refused the request.

codes.name: BILLING_SUBSCRIPTION_ACTIVE
codes.summary: The organization already has a subscription. Change it in the billing portal.

codes.name: BILLING_SUSPENDED
codes.summary: The organization is suspended for an unpaid balance. Update its payment method in the billing portal.

codes.name: CREDENTIAL_DELIVERY_EXPIRED
codes.summary: The credential delivery expired or can no longer be redeemed.

codes.name: CREDENTIAL_EXPIRED
codes.summary: The credential carried by the stored result has expired. Request a new one.

codes.name: CREDENTIAL_REFRESH_REQUIRED
codes.summary: The media credential must be refreshed before connecting.

codes.name: CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED
codes.summary: Delivery-permit requests cannot be resolved by lookup. Obtain a current permit and resubmit the same delivery explicitly.

codes.name: CURSOR_AHEAD
codes.summary: The cursor is ahead of the committed events of the conversation.

codes.name: CURSOR_EXPIRED
codes.summary: The cursor is older than retained history. Resynchronize from current state; never reset the cursor silently.

codes.name: CURSOR_INVALID
codes.summary: The cursor is malformed or was not issued for this query.

codes.name: CURSOR_MISMATCH
codes.summary: The cursor does not continue the subscribed stream.

codes.name: CURSOR_SCOPE_MISMATCH
codes.summary: The cursor was issued for a different scope, caller or visibility.

codes.name: DELIVERY_CONSUMED
codes.summary: The delivery was already redeemed by a different request.

codes.name: DELIVERY_NOT_REDEEMED
codes.summary: The delivery must be redeemed before it can be acknowledged.

codes.name: DEPLOYMENT_NOT_READY
codes.summary: The deployment cannot host projects yet.

codes.name: FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED
codes.summary: The feature is not available in this deployment.

codes.name: FORBIDDEN
codes.summary: The credential is valid but not allowed to perform this operation.

codes.name: GENERATION_CONFLICT
codes.summary: The live session generation changed. Read the current generation and retry.

codes.name: GRAPHQL_ERROR
codes.summary: A GraphQL error arrived without a recognized code.

codes.name: GRAPHQL_INVALID_REQUEST
codes.summary: The GraphQL request is malformed or fails validation.

codes.name: GRAPHQL_QUERY_LIMIT
codes.summary: The GraphQL document exceeds a depth, complexity or size limit.

codes.name: GRAPHQL_RESPONSE_LIMIT
codes.summary: The query response exceeds the response limit. Request a smaller page.

codes.name: HTTP_FAILURE
codes.summary: The HTTP exchange failed without a usable GraphQL error.

codes.name: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
codes.summary: The requestId was already used with a different payload or caller.

codes.name: INCARNATION_MISMATCH
codes.summary: The project incarnation changed. Discard state from the old incarnation and recover explicitly.

codes.name: INVALID_REPLACEMENT
codes.summary: The connection to replace is not a current connection of this participation.

codes.name: INVALID_REQUEST
codes.summary: The input or request context failed validation.

codes.name: INVALID_RESPONSE
codes.summary: The response did not match the expected shape or identity. The outcome is unknown.

codes.name: LIVE_ALERT_LIMIT
codes.summary: The live session reached its alert limit.

codes.name: LIVE_SESSION_CLOSED
codes.summary: The live session has ended or is ending.

codes.name: LIVE_SESSION_EXISTS
codes.summary: The conversation already has an active live session.

codes.name: MEDIA_CONNECT_FAILED
codes.summary: The native media connection failed. The participation remains; resolve and reconnect, or leave explicitly.

codes.name: MEDIA_FENCE_REQUIRED
codes.summary: Media cutoff is not enforced yet for this live session. Retry after the cutoff completes.

codes.name: MEDIA_NOT_READY
codes.summary: Media for the live session is not ready yet.

codes.name: MEDIA_RECOVERING
codes.summary: Media for the live session is recovering.

codes.name: MEMBERSHIP_COUNT_INVALID
codes.summary: Membership accounting needs operator reconciliation.

codes.name: MEMBER_LIMIT
codes.summary: The conversation reached its member limit.

codes.name: MESSAGE_DELETED
codes.summary: The message was deleted.

codes.name: NOT_A_SESSION_REQUEST
codes.summary: The requestId does not belong to an issueSession or renewSession request.

codes.name: NOT_FOUND
codes.summary: The resource does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

codes.name: OUTCOME_UNKNOWN
codes.summary: The mutation may have committed. Retry with the same requestId or resolve it.

codes.name: PAGE_ITEM_TOO_LARGE
codes.summary: A single item exceeds the page response limit.

codes.name: PARTICIPATION_MISMATCH
codes.summary: The participation does not belong to the caller or the current live session generation.

codes.name: PERMIT_EXPIRED
codes.summary: The stored delivery permit has expired. Request a new permit.

codes.name: PLAN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
codes.summary: The plan does not permit the resource or feature. extensions.planLimit names the limit and extensions.limit holds the plan's value. Change the plan or the limit before trying again.

codes.name: QUOTA_EXCEEDED
codes.summary: A hard usage quota refused new work until the quota period ends. extensions.meter, extensions.limit and extensions.periodEnd describe the quota, and extensions.retryAfter (HTTP Retry-After) counts the seconds until it resets. Work already in progress continues.

codes.name: RATE_LIMITED
codes.summary: A per-second rate limit refused the request before it had any effect. Wait extensions.retryAfter seconds (HTTP Retry-After), then resend the request with the same requestId.

codes.name: RECOVERY_LIMIT
codes.summary: The SDK's recovery store already holds 128 mutation records that are not final, so the new request was not sent. Retry or resolve outstanding requests, then send it again.

codes.name: RECOVERY_STORAGE_FAILURE
codes.summary: Caller-provided recovery storage did not confirm durability. Keep the original request and its outcome.

codes.name: REQUEST_EXPIRED
codes.summary: The original request is too old to replay.

codes.name: REQUEST_TOO_LARGE
codes.summary: The request body exceeds the size limit.

codes.name: RESOLUTION_REQUIRED
codes.summary: The outcome is still unresolved and the retry budget is spent. Resolve the original request before continuing.

codes.name: RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE
codes.summary: The response exceeds the size limit.

codes.name: RESYNC_REQUIRED
codes.summary: The subscription cannot continue. Replay from the last applied cursor.

codes.name: RETRY_EXHAUSTED
codes.summary: The authority exhausted its internal retry budget. Retry later with the same requestId.

codes.name: REVISION_CONFLICT
codes.summary: The expected revision or epoch is stale. Read the current state and retry with a new request.

codes.name: SCOPE_REQUIRED
codes.summary: The backend key lacks a scope this operation requires. The message names the scope.

codes.name: SESSION_RECEIPT_BINDING_MISMATCH
codes.summary: The stored session receipt does not match its binding.

codes.name: SESSION_RECEIPT_INVALID
codes.summary: The stored session receipt failed validation.

codes.name: SESSION_REFRESH_FAILED
codes.summary: The application session refresh callback failed.

codes.name: SESSION_REFRESH_REJECTED
codes.summary: The refreshed session was rejected because it does not match the current session.

codes.name: SESSION_REFRESH_REQUIRED
codes.summary: The user session needs renewal and no refresh is configured, or it expired.

codes.name: SESSION_REFRESH_UNVERIFIED
codes.summary: The refreshed session could not be verified.

codes.name: TRANSPORT_UNKNOWN
codes.summary: The transport failed after the request may have been sent. Resolve or retry the original request.

codes.name: UNAUTHENTICATED
codes.summary: The credential is missing, invalid or expired.

codes.name: WEBHOOK_DESTINATION_DENIED
codes.summary: The webhook URL is not a public HTTPS destination.

codes.name: WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_DISABLED
codes.summary: The webhook endpoint is disabled. Enable it, then replay its deliveries.

codes.name: WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_LIMIT
codes.summary: The project reached its webhook endpoint limit.

codes.name: WEBHOOK_ROTATION_PENDING
codes.summary: A signing-secret rotation is already waiting for acknowledgement.

codes.name: WEBHOOK_SECRET_UNACKNOWLEDGED
codes.summary: The endpoint's signing secret has not been acknowledged yet.

codes.name: WRONG_REGION
codes.summary: The observed serving epoch is stale. Route again, then retry.

document.text:
query CommunicationSessionRequestOutcome($context: RequestContextInput!, $input: SessionRequestOutcomeRequestInput!) {
  sessionRequestOutcome(context: $context, input: $input) {
    status
    requestId
    serverTime
    result {
      state
      requestId
      checkedAt
      operation
      receiptId
      committedAt
      originalSession {
        sessionId
        principalId
        deviceId
        incarnation
        sessionRevision
        expiresAt
        status
      }
      currentSession {
        sessionId
        principalId
        deviceId
        incarnation
        sessionRevision
        expiresAt
        status
      }
      currentState
    }
  }
}

document.text:
mutation CommunicationLiveSessionCredentials($context: RequestContextInput!, $input: LiveSessionCredentialsInput!) {
  liveSessionCredentials(context: $context, input: $input) {
    status
    requestId
    receiptId
    committedAt
    replayed
    result {
      liveSessionId
      participationId
      generation
      roomName
      participantIdentity
      livekitUrl
      transportToken
      admissionTicket
      forwardingLease
      transportExpiresAt
      admissionExpiresAt
      leaseExpiresAt
      leasePolicyId
      connectToken
    }
  }
}

document.text:
query ManagementWebhookEndpoints($context: RequestContextInput!, $input: WebhookEndpointsRequestInput!) {
  webhookEndpoints(context: $context, input: $input) {
    status
    requestId
    serverTime
    receiptId
    committedAt
    replayed
    operation {
      operationId
      owner
      href
      state
    }
    resourceRef {
      kind
      id
    }
    result {
      items {
        endpointId
        url
        eventTypes
        enabled
        status
        disabledReason
        revision
        secretVersion
        rotationPending
        rotationOverlapUntil
        consecutiveFailures
        failingSince
        lastSuccessAt
        lastFailureAt
      }
      complete
      refreshRequired
      nextCursor
      observedAt
      partialReason
    }
  }
}

operations.summary: List recent deliveries of a webhook endpoint.

document.text:
query ManagementWebhookDeliveries($context: RequestContextInput!, $input: WebhookDeliveriesRequestInput!) {
  webhookDeliveries(context: $context, input: $input) {
    status
    requestId
    serverTime
    receiptId
    committedAt
    replayed
    operation {
      operationId
      owner
      href
      state
    }
    resourceRef {
      kind
      id
    }
    result {
      items {
        effectId
        eventId
        state
        attempts
        lastOutcome
        nextAttemptAt
        eventType
        createdAt
        replayedAt
        lastAttemptAt
        lastHttpStatus
        lastLatencyMs
        lastErrorCode
      }
      complete
      refreshRequired
      nextCursor
      observedAt
      partialReason
      sourceRevision
    }
  }
}

types.name: Decimal
types.summary: Non-negative 64-bit counter as a canonical decimal string. Never convert it to a floating-point number.

types.name: PlanLimitExceededProblem
types.description: GraphQL error `extensions` when `code` is `PLAN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`. The plan does not permit the resource or feature (`status` 403 in an HTTP 200 GraphQL response, WebSocket close 4403). Not retryable without a plan or limit change.

fields.name: planLimit
fields.description: `maxProjects`, `broadcastEnabled`, or a canonical usage meter key whose allowance is zero.

fields.name: limit
fields.description: The plan's value for `planLimit`: a decimal count, or `false` for a disabled feature.

types.name: Properties
types.summary: Application-defined JSON object. Numbers must stay within the interoperable safe-integer range.

types.name: QuotaExceededProblem
types.description: GraphQL error `extensions` when `code` is `QUOTA_EXCEEDED`. A hard usage quota refused new work until the period ends (HTTP 429, WebSocket close 4429). Calls and connections already in progress continue. Not retryable before `periodEnd`.

fields.name: retryAfter
fields.description: Whole seconds before the same request may succeed; HTTP responses repeat it in `Retry-After`.

fields.name: meter
fields.description: Canonical usage meter key, such as `connection_minutes`.

fields.name: periodEnd
fields.description: RFC 3339 UTC end of the quota period.

types.name: RateLimitedProblem
types.description: GraphQL error `extensions` when `code` is `RATE_LIMITED`. A per-second limit refused the request before any effect (HTTP 429, WebSocket close 4429). Resend the same request identity after `retryAfter` seconds.

fields.name: retryAfter
fields.description: Whole seconds before the same request may succeed; HTTP responses repeat it in `Retry-After`.

types.name: RetainedResult
types.description: Exactly one typed field contains the retained, currently authorized receipt result.

types.name: SignedProof
types.summary: Server-signed JSON object. Treat it as opaque and pass it back unchanged.

types.name: UUID
types.summary: Canonical lowercase UUID. The nil UUID is rejected.
